summary: ISS-2699 is the 4th re-raise of the known-benign orphan_file condition (ISS-2562/2658/2671 all closed). This run completed the FULL 68/68 audit the prior spot-checks lacked: every orphan is benign — 75 file-refs resolve to closed-issues.json, 2 (ISS-1880, ISS-1750) were closed via closure-ledger.jsonl (burndown/M1 mechanisms — invisible to closed-issues lookups, which is why they previously read as absent), 1 is an operator-direct experiment (EXP-401) never tracker-routed by design. Zero open ISS refs, zero lost work. Close ISS-2699 citing EXP-614; if integrity re-raises before PROP-088 lands, close on sight — no analyst run needed. Root-cause fix remains PROP-088 (proposed 2026-06-10, awaiting tinker); recommend prioritizing it, optionally extending the script to also consult closure-ledger.jsonl.
